_why: One source of route verdicts, read by scripts/route-deletion-impact.mjs and by the verdict-list generator. A verdict here comes from the thread that owns the file, with that thread's own reason; nothing in this file is the checker's inference. KEEP_STATUSES are the verdicts that mean the route is NOT being deleted, so the impact report must not count its handler as dying — without this, requirePlatformAdmin() and the whole walk-forward chain were reported as falling with routes their owners had already ruled kept.
